title: Derived price lists
description: A price list worked out from another: each rule says the target list's price is the source list's price times a factor, plus an offset, rounded to a step at the shop's decimal places and never below a floor. The app's service, outside the shop, follows price changes on the event feed and writes the target list's item prices; a price a person set at the target is never overwritten. After install: give the role PP DPL Integration read on Price List, and read, create and write on Item Price; make the integration user with that role and its API key; choose the user on the feed registration PP DPL Prices and tick Item Price; add a PP DPL Rule and tick Enabled. What leaves the shop: the service reads the rules, the price lists and the item prices, and writes item prices; with these rights its key can change any item price in the shop.

fields.label: Rule name (short: it is written in each price it makes)
Target price list (written by the app)
Factor (1.5 = half as much again; 0.9 = ten per cent less)
Decimal places (the shop's currency precision: 2 for most currencies, 0 for a currency with no cents)
